lyrics: The world is too loud and it's   full of deceit
I found a shelter, a   quiet retreat
is so simple in this sacred space
perfect reflection is on every face.
Don't need any windows, don't need any doors
whispers confirm what I knew all before
new message, a nail in the wall
glad I'm in here, away from the fall.
They call it a bubble, I call it a
Why would I ever want to walk out
facts are just poison, their   logic is weak
The righteous are listening when our leaders speak.
This is our fortress, we'll drown you
This is our truth,   and this is
clear!        We only hear the voices
we know       that we are right!
